id: 30_BIORISK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM FULL LECTURE (CC-BY)(Free for Reuse)
title: 把生物安全管成一个体系
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/30_BIORISK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM FULL LECTURE (CC-BY)(Free for Reuse).md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/30_BIORISK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM FULL LECTURE (CC-BY)(Free for Reuse)/src.py

points.K1: 体系：一组相互关联的过程
points.K4: 练习：给设想的实验室写方案
points.K8: 建实验室前问五个问题
points.K12: 每一步都有人，都要培训

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一张由齿轮连成的大图前，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a big diagram of interlocking gears and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 生物安全，靠一个人盯不住，
overlay: 把生物安全管成一个体系

shots.scene: 齿轮一起转动起来
shots.prompt_en: The interlocking gears start turning together. No people.
shots.narration: 要靠一整套体系转起来。

shots.scene: 老周在办公室里看一张空白的新实验室平面图
shots.prompt_en: The older man studies a blank floor plan for a new laboratory in his office.
shots.narration: 老周课题组要新建一个病毒检测实验室。

shots.scene: 老周向王老师请教，桌上放着空白文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The older man consults the safety administrator; blank folders lie on the desk.
shots.narration: 他去找王老师：安全要从哪里抓起？

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰在门口探头听
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student listen at the doorway.
shots.narration: 小研和阿杰也来旁听。

shots.section_title: 体系：一组相互关联的过程
shots.scene: 王老师在白板上画出几个方框，用箭头连起来
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator draws several blank boxes on a whiteboard and links them with arrows.
shots.narration: 实验室里的事，是一环扣一环的。
overlay: 体系：一组相互关联的过程

shots.section_title: 体系：一组相互关联的过程
shots.scene: 一个齿轮卡住，其他齿轮都停了
shots.prompt_en: One gear jams and all the linked gears stop. No people.
shots.narration: 一环出错，整条链都受影响。

shots.section_title: 体系：一组相互关联的过程
shots.scene: 齿轮重新转动，旁边是循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: The gears turn again beside a circular improvement arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 把这些环节一起管，还要不断改进。

shots.scene: 三本书叠在一起：显微镜、法槌、扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked books marked with a microscope icon, a gavel icon and a wrench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 管生物安全，要懂三门学问：

shots.scene: 老李指着天花板上的风管和地面下水管示意
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points to the air ducts above the ceiling and the drain pipes below the floor.
shots.narration: 气流方向、空调、给排水，都要懂一点。

shots.scene: 王老师在书架前一年年添书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator adds books to a shelf year after year, shown by changing calendar pages.
shots.narration: 这些本事，要在工作中慢慢积累。

shots.scene: 五级台阶，每级一个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five steps of a staircase, each with an icon: gears, a scroll, a map, a wrench and a magnifier. No people.
shots.narration: 这一课讲五件事：

shots.scene: 欣欣沿台阶往上走
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot climbs the five steps one by one.
shots.narration: 体系、方针、策划、实施、评审。

shots.section_title: 练习：给设想的实验室写方案
shots.scene: 阿杰面前一张空白纸，上面画着虚线的实验室轮廓
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits before a blank sheet with a dashed outline of an imaginary laboratory.
shots.narration: 没在生物实验室工作？没关系，
overlay: 练习：给设想的实验室写方案

shots.section_title: 练习：给设想的实验室写方案
shots.scene: 阿杰依次写下四个空白小标题卡片
shots.prompt_en: The young male student fills in four blank cards one after another.
shots.narration: 设想一个实验室，写方针、写计划，

shots.section_title: 练习：给设想的实验室写方案
shots.scene: 卡片排成一圈
shots.prompt_en: The four cards arranged in a circle with arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 再想想怎么落实、怎么检查改进。

shots.scene: 五根横条依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Five horizontal bars light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 建体系，有五个要素：

shots.scene: 欣欣指着五根横条
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the five glowing bars.
shots.narration: 先定义，再搭结构，理解它，改进它，

shots.scene: 钱袋和人形图标放在横条末端
shots.prompt_en: A coin stack icon and a person icon sit at the end of the bars. No people.
shots.narration: 还要事先看清资源够不够。

shots.scene: 老周在一张空白卷轴上签名
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank scroll at his desk.
shots.narration: 一切从一份方针开始。

shots.scene: 卷轴上浮现三个图标：握手、上升箭头、天平
shots.prompt_en: Three icons float above the scroll: a handshake, a rising arrow and a balance scale. No people.
shots.narration: 方针写明三点：

shots.scene: 握手图标放大
shots.prompt_en: The handshake icon grows larger. No people.
shots.narration: 单位承诺，把安全放进主业；

shots.scene: 上升箭头和天平图标并排
shots.prompt_en: The rising arrow and balance scale icons side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 不断改进，符合国际和国家的指南法规。

shots.scene: 四色循环：策划、实施、检查、改进
shots.prompt_en: A four-colour cycle diagram with icons of a plan sheet, a hand, a magnifier and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 改进靠一个循环：

shots.scene: 循环沿斜坡往上滚
shots.prompt_en: The cycle wheel rolls up a gentle slope. No people.
shots.narration: 转一圈，水平就提高一点。

shots.section_title: 建实验室前问五个问题
shots.scene: 老周、王老师围着平面图，五个问号气泡
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator stand at the floor plan with five question mark bubbles above.
shots.narration: 建实验室之前，先问五个问题。
overlay: 建实验室前问五个问题

shots.section_title: 建实验室前问五个问题
shots.scene: 仪器、空白规程本图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of laboratory instruments and a blank procedure binder. No people.
shots.narration: 做哪些实验？要什么仪器和规程？

shots.section_title: 建实验室前问五个问题
shots.scene: 排班表和分工图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank duty roster and task assignment icons. No people.
shots.narration: 工作怎么安排，谁做什么？

shots.section_title: 建实验室前问五个问题
shots.scene: 运输箱、灭活、废物桶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a transport box, an inactivation step and a waste bin with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 还牵涉运输、灭活、废物几个环节？

shots.section_title: 建实验室前问五个问题
shots.scene: 盾牌和沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon next to an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 怎样更安全、更高效？

shots.section_title: 建实验室前问五个问题
shots.scene: 钱袋和人形图标打问号
shots.prompt_en: A coin stack icon and a person icon each with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 最后：有哪些限制？

shots.scene: 规程本中间有一个缺口，红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A procedure binder with a gap in its pages, marked with a red exclamation icon. No people.
shots.narration: 运行中出了事故或事件，

shots.scene: 小裂缝变成大裂缝的示意，被手按住
shots.prompt_en: A small crack about to widen into a big crack is held shut by a hand. No people.
shots.narration: 说明规程有漏洞，要趁小补上。

shots.scene: 钱袋图标，旁边空了一半的储钱罐
shots.prompt_en: A half-empty piggy bank next to a coin icon. No people.
shots.narration: 限制可能是经费不够，

shots.scene: 岗位空缺的椅子
shots.prompt_en: An empty chair at a workstation with a blank vacancy card. No people.
shots.narration: 也可能是缺少合格的人。

shots.scene: 白板上依次画出样本管、培养皿、显微镜图标
shots.prompt_en: On the whiteboard icons appear in a row: a sample tube, a culture dish and a microscope, linked by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 把检测流程一步步画出来：

shots.scene: 接着出现文件夹和云上传图标
shots.prompt_en: A folder icon and a secure cloud upload icon with a padlock follow. No people.
shots.narration: 检测完要记录，结果安全上传。

shots.scene: 显微镜下方红箭头指向废物桶
shots.prompt_en: A red arrow points down from the microscope to a waste bin with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 每一步，都会产生废物，

shots.scene: 废物桶指向高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: The waste bin with an arrow to an autoclave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要按规程去污、合规处置。

shots.section_title: 每一步都有人，都要培训
shots.scene: 每个流程图标上方出现一个不同颜色的人形
shots.prompt_en: A small person icon of a different colour appears above each step of the workflow. No people.
shots.narration: 每一步，都有专人负责，
overlay: 每一步都有人，都要培训

shots.section_title: 每一步都有人，都要培训
shots.scene: 小研在柜前接受带教，王老师旁边指导
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student practises sample handling at a biological safety cabinet while the safety administrator coaches her.
shots.narration: 处理样本的，学样本处理规程；

shots.section_title: 每一步都有人，都要培训
shots.scene: 阿杰在废物间学习，老李讲解
shots.prompt_en: The young male student learns waste handling in the waste room while the facility engineer explains.
shots.narration: 管废物的，也要学废物规程。

shots.scene: 靶心图标和流程方框
shots.prompt_en: A target icon next to a row of blank process boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 第一步定义：定目标，划过程。

shots.scene: 老周在平面图上圈出范围
shots.prompt_en: The older man draws a boundary around the work area on the floor plan.
shots.narration: 这个实验室做什么，范围到哪。

shots.scene: 组织架构图，每个方框下有一个人形
shots.prompt_en: An organization chart of blank boxes, each with a small person icon beneath. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步搭结构：谁负责什么，

shots.scene: 每个人手里拿着一本空白规程
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student each hold a blank procedure binder.
shots.narration: 每个人按哪份规程做。

shots.scene: 相互咬合的齿轮，旁边一个人形
shots.prompt_en: Interlocking gears with a person icon among them. No people.
shots.narration: 第三步理解：环节相互依存，

shots.scene: 阿杰深夜趴在实验台前打哈欠，红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: Late at night, the young male student yawns over the bench, with a red exclamation icon.
shots.narration: 人也有极限，疲劳最容易出事。

shots.scene: 老周调整排班表，把任务分匀
shots.prompt_en: The older man rearranges a blank roster to spread tasks evenly.
shots.narration: 工作分配要均衡，培训要到位。

shots.scene: 事故报告单箭头指向放大镜，再指向规程本
shots.prompt_en: A blank incident report with an arrow to a magnifier, then to a procedure binder. No people.
shots.narration: 第四步改进：盯住事故和事件，

shots.scene: 规程本里替换一页
shots.prompt_en: A page in the procedure binder is replaced with a new one. No people.
shots.narration: 找到缺口，修订规程去补上。

shots.scene: 天平一边是任务，一边是钱袋和人形
shots.prompt_en: A balance with task icons on one side and coins and people icons on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 第五步：没有完美的体系，

shots.scene: 老周在计划书上列出限制项
shots.prompt_en: The older man lists constraints on a blank planning sheet.
shots.narration: 设施花钱、人手不足，事先认清。

shots.scene: 金字塔底座发光
shots.prompt_en: The glowing base of a pyramid. No people.
shots.narration: 体系成功的地基，是领导承诺。

shots.scene: 老周把方针卷轴挂上墙，再递出钱袋图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man hangs the policy scroll on the wall and hands over a coin icon.
shots.narration: 负责人认领方针，给足资源，

shots.scene: 安全图标排在任务清单第一位
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon placed at the top of a task list. No people.
shots.narration: 把安全放在优先位置。

shots.scene: 老周向全组讲方针，小研、阿杰、老李都在场
shots.prompt_en: The older man explains the policy to the female graduate student, the young male student and the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 方针要讲给每个人，

shots.scene: 清洁推车和废物转运车图标旁也贴着方针
shots.prompt_en: A cleaning cart icon and a waste trolley icon next to the policy scroll on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 保洁、清运人员也不例外。

shots.scene: 盾牌和锁两个图标合在一起
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon and a padlock icon merge into one. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全和生物安保一起管，

shots.scene: 全组人员各自在岗，头顶有盾牌小图标
shots.prompt_en: Team members work at their posts, each with a small shield icon above their head.
shots.narration: 变成每个人的习惯。

shots.scene: 放大镜对准问题，箭头往下挖到树根
shots.prompt_en: A magnifier over a problem with an arrow digging down to the roots of a tree. No people.
shots.narration: 出了问题，要查到根本原因，

shots.scene: 扳手图标修好链条
shots.prompt_en: A wrench icon fixes a broken chain link. No people.
shots.narration: 采取纠正措施，同时找改进机会。

shots.scene: 七个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Seven icons in a row: a key, a calendar, a gauge, a shield, a book, a target and a medal. No people.
shots.narration: 持续改进，要做七件事：

shots.scene: 钥匙、日历、仪表图标放大
shots.prompt_en: The key, calendar and gauge icons enlarge. No people.
shots.narration: 人人有主人翁意识，定期评估，

shots.scene: 盾牌、书本图标放大
shots.prompt_en: The shield and book icons enlarge. No people.
shots.narration: 规程有效，预防在先，持续培训，

shots.scene: 靶心和奖牌图标放大
shots.prompt_en: The target and medal icons enlarge. No people.
shots.narration: 定改进目标，表扬做得好的人。

shots.scene: 三个相连的圆圈：放大镜、盾牌、勾号
shots.prompt_en: Three connected circles with a magnifier, a shield and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 策划，从风险评估开始：

shots.scene: 王老师在空白评估表上画出危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator marks hazard icons on a blank assessment sheet.
shots.narration: 识别危害、评估风险、管住风险。

shots.scene: 书架上一排法规书，脊上空白
shots.prompt_en: A row of law books with blank spines on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 还要找全相关的法律法规，

shots.scene: 地球、国旗轮廓、城市三层图标
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked layers of icons: a globe, a flag outline and a city skyline. No people.
shots.narration: 国际、国家、地方各级的要求，

shots.scene: 要求清单逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: A requirements checklist being ticked item by item. No people.
shots.narration: 逐项对照，一项不落地落实。

shots.scene: 靶心旁写着空白指标卡
shots.prompt_en: A target icon beside blank indicator cards. No people.
shots.narration: 定下控制目标和指标，

shots.scene: 文件夹归档，箭头可以往回追溯
shots.prompt_en: Folders filed in order with an arrow tracing back through them. No people.
shots.narration: 写成文件，事后能追溯。

shots.scene: 五个图标：架构图、名牌、证书、书本、喇叭
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: an organization chart, a name badge, a certificate, a book and a megaphone. No people.
shots.narration: 计划落地，要做五件事：

shots.scene: 老周给小研、阿杰分发名牌
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands blank name badges to the female graduate student and the young male student.
shots.narration: 搭架构，分职责，任命合格的人，

shots.scene: 王老师上培训课，喇叭图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a training session, with a megaphone icon beside her.
shots.narration: 抓培训，把方针和做法讲到位。

shots.scene: 层级架构图：顶部两层和一个委员会方框
shots.prompt_en: An organization chart: two top boxes and a committee box below them. No people.
shots.narration: 组织结构：最高和高级管理层在上，

shots.scene: 王老师站在架构图中间
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands at the centre of the chart.
shots.narration: 生物风险管理者和委员会居中把关。

shots.scene: 老李在设备层检查风机
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a fan unit on the plant floor.
shots.narration: 设施工程师管电、管风、管空调；

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员巡查门禁和电脑锁屏
shots.prompt_en: The security officer checks an access door and a locked computer screen.
shots.narration: 安保既管物理安全，也管数据安全。

shots.scene: 职业健康图标和动物房图标
shots.prompt_en: An occupational health icon and an animal facility icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还有职业健康、动物管理和外部顾问。

shots.scene: 八宫格图标墙
shots.prompt_en: A wall of eight icon tiles. No people.
shots.narration: 日常运行，要管好八个方面：

shots.scene: 运行控制和一般安全图标：闪电、化学瓶
shots.prompt_en: Tiles showing operational control, an electric bolt and a chemical bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 运行控制，电气化学等一般安全，

shots.scene: 库存清单和排班表图标
shots.prompt_en: Tiles showing an inventory list and a duty roster. No people.
shots.narration: 库存台账，工作计划，

shots.scene: 规范操作和废物桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Tiles showing a check mark for work practices and a waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 操作规范，废物管理，

shots.scene: 人员和扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: Tiles showing a group of people and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 人员管理，设施的保养和维修。

shots.scene: 日历上圈出评审日，老周主持会议
shots.prompt_en: The older man chairs a review meeting, with a review date circled on a calendar.
shots.narration: 最高管理层按计划定期评审体系，

shots.scene: 日历上同时圈出年、月、周三种格子
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a year box, a month box and a week box each circled. No people.
shots.narration: 周期由最高层定，可按年、月或周。

shots.scene: 三个勾号图标
shots.prompt_en: Three check mark icons in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 看它合不合适、够不够、有没有效。

shots.scene: 上升箭头
shots.prompt_en: A rising arrow with a small lightbulb. No people.
shots.narration: 再找下一步改进的机会。

shots.scene: 会议桌上摊开一叠空白材料
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank reports spread on the meeting table. No people.
shots.narration: 评审要看这些材料：

shots.scene: 审核报告、规程执行记录、评估表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an audit report, a procedure compliance record and a risk assessment sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 审核结果、规程执行、评估进展，

shots.scene: 纠正措施清单、上次评审记录图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a corrective action list and last review minutes. No people.
shots.narration: 纠正预防措施、上次评审的跟进，

shots.scene: 改进建议和事故调查报告图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an improvement suggestion card and an incident investigation report. No people.
shots.narration: 改进建议，还有事故事件调查。

shots.scene: 一排归档整齐的文件夹
shots.prompt_en: A neat row of filed folders. No people.
shots.narration: 每一步都有记录，评审才有依据。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着法规书
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a law book with a blank cover.
shots.narration: 最后，找出本国的法规和指南，

shots.scene: 两本空白封面的书并排：盾牌图标和锁图标
shots.prompt_en: Two books with blank covers side by side, one with a shield icon and one with a padlock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全和生物安保的文件都要找。

shots.scene: 老周把法规书放进实验室文件柜
shots.prompt_en: The older man places the books into the laboratory document cabinet.
